scope: development-only monotone p95 and exact-false-positive-tail calibration

folds.holdout_status: not independent after the preceding p95-only calibration

constraints_per_selection_fold: calibrated negative-scene logit p95 no higher than current
calibrated false positives at the operational threshold no greater than current
calibration.tail_limit: shift the first raw negative beyond the current false-positive budget below the operational threshold
calibration.aggregate_rule: minimum of every p95 and exact-tail offset limit across selection folds, minus the fixed conservative margin
calibration.direction: negative only; every scene score must strictly decrease

gates.selection: every fold satisfies both tail constraints and preserves raw-ensemble AP exactly
gates.reused_holdout_audit: the identical fixed offset satisfies both tail constraints and preserves AP on folds 0/1

invariants: No fresh CloudSEN score or paper-cache input is loaded.
Only selection folds determine the offset.
The first disallowed negative order statistic enforces the current false-positive budget without a parameter search.
A constant logit offset preserves rankings, AP, AUROC, and matched-FPR recall.
Folds 0/1 are reported only as a reused audit, never as new independent confirmation.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks fresh replay.
